payload.author: impl:1@run-125
payload.body:
Task 1 done: 150 files deleted, nothing else touched. My own Proof is green:
  leg (a) absence loop over all 150 — exits 0
  leg (b) presence loop + `git diff --quiet BASE` over all 16 survivors — exits 0
  leg (c) `pytest --collect-only -q tests/test_fleet_suite.py` — 9 test_fleet_mjs rows, 0 naming run_69

PLAN DEFECT for whoever folds this (global constraint 3, whole-suite green): `python3 -m pytest -p no:xdist` is 3 failed, 787 passed. All three reds are protected survivors that read files this task's Files block deletes. Each was verified GREEN at BASE in a throwaway worktree, so the deletion is the cause:

  1. fleet/tests/test_readiness_fold_order_exam.mjs — it IS the exam for fleet/tests/test_readiness_fold_order.mjs, which is on the delete list. It asserts 'the implementation does not exist yet: the sim fleet/tests/test_readiness_fold_order.mjs is absent'. Keeping an exam whose subject is deleted looks like a curation slip in the 16-file survivor list.
  2. fleet/tests/test_sims_are_hermetic.mjs — leg (e), NESTED_AT_BASE at lines 873-880, hardcodes 7 sim names and their sibling lists and does fs.existsSync on each. All 7 sims and all but one sibling (test_run_engine_proof_runs.mjs) are on the delete list. 8 FAILED inside that sim.
  3. fleet/tests/test_run_engine_proof_runs.mjs — copyWithProbe() does fs.readFileSync on four sims by name (lines ~930-970): test_run_engine_pre_review.mjs, test_run_engine_implementer_suite.mjs, test_run_engine_integrated_runs.mjs are all deleted. ENOENT.

No fix is available to this task: repairing any of the three means editing one of the 16, which global constraint 2 forbids and my own Proof leg (b) diffs against BASE. So this is implemented as written and reported. The plan needs to either drop those three from the survivor list, or hand a follow-up task ownership of them.

Also: the Context says 'the six files under fleet/tests/exams/run_69/ are ... in this task's list'. They are not — fleet/tests/exams/ does not exist at BASE and no exams/ path appears in the Files block. Harmless: M3's run_69 clause is 0 either way.
